name: Gästehaus Auer
beschreibung: The Gästehaus Auer is located in the quiet municipality of Thiersee in the Tiroler Unterinntal. The surroundings are characterized by gentle hills and the Thiersee, which invites you to take walks. The accommodation offers guests a family-like atmosphere and well-equipped holiday apartments. Those seeking relaxation can explore nature on hikes or bike tours. In winter, cross-country ski trails and ski areas are available nearby. The region is also known for its traditional inns.
